correctness.rationale: For compact invariant μ supported in 0<m≤X≤M<∞, Y=log(X/K) and Y² are bounded. The EXACT cocycle Y∘F−Y=r(1−X/K) integrates to E[X]=K. Squaring the increment gives 0=−2r E[Y(X/K−1)]+r²E[(1−X/K)²]. Divide by r>0 and rescale to 2K Cov(log X,X)=r Var(X). Non-Dirac means Var(X)>0 and recovers r; Var=0 forces δ_K, invariant for every r. Mean K and non-Dirac force positive mass on both sides. Finite rational checker fetched at exact package path verifies expansion and rescaling only, not the invariant-law theorem.
